annotations.title: Find contracts for a business description

description: Rank open CanadaBuys and Alberta Purchasing Connection notices for a free-text business description. A commodity-code and term prefilter cuts the catalogues to a short candidate list, then TypeSafe Jev classifies each notice: could this business supply it (yes, partial, or no) and as which capability (goods supply, services, training, or subcontract). Yes and partial results are ordered by that verdict, then by the existing keyword score and Buy Canadian bonus. If Jev is not configured or rejects the key, keyword ranking is used and the result says so. The description and a short notice summary are sent to TypeSafe when classification runs. See /privacy. workspaceAlberta does not submit a bid or decide eligibility. When a business description is present and TypeSafe is configured, notice text and that description are sent to TypeSafe for supply-fit classification. See /privacy.

company_name.description: Optional company name for the heading.

days.description: Only show notices closing within N days (default 120, max 365)

description.description: What the business does, in its own words. Example: a bakery in Red Deer that bakes at scale and teaches culinary skills.

location.description: Where the business works, such as Red Deer, Alberta.

profile.description: Inline business profile used for this call only. Overrides any saved profile. On the shared public endpoint without a subscriber key, this is the way to describe your business.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability keywords; derived from description when omitted

description.description: What the business does: products, services, capabilities

industries.description: Optional sector labels for any business. Steel, lumber, aluminum, and construction still work. So do software, healthcare, energy, mining, training, or your own wording. Labels rank matches. They do not hide other contracts.

location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Edmonton, Alberta'

province.description: Optional province or delivery region filter

name: find_business_fit

closes_at.description: Closing time as ISO 8601 in Alberta time with UTC offset; empty when unknown

closing.description: Closing value exactly as the source published it

domestic_policies.description: Buy Canadian and domestic-preference flags read from the notice

gsin.description: GSIN code from CanadaBuys, when published

unspsc.description: UNSPSC code or codes from the source, when published

title: Find contracts for a business description
